description: Source file implementing utility functions and classes for managing Dispmanx resources and rendering on Raspberry Pi 4, including resource creation, data writing, clearing, and video rendering management.

classes.name: DispmanxAutoUpdate
classes.description: Helper class managing start and commit of Dispmanx updates, ensuring proper update submission and handle management.

classes.name: DispmanxResource
classes.description: Represents a Dispmanx image resource with specified type and dimensions.

classes.name: DispmanxYUV420Resource
classes.description: Specialized resource for YUV420 image data.

classes.name: DispmanxRGB565Resource
classes.description: Specialized resource for RGB565 image data.

classes.name: DispmanxElement
classes.description: Represents a Dispmanx element (layer) in the display, allowing creation, removal, and source change.

classes.name: DispmanxVideoRenderer
classes.description: Manages video rendering using Dispmanx elements, including updating frames and hiding/showing elements.

methods.name: WriteData
methods.description: Writes pixel data to the Dispmanx resource.

methods.name: ClearWithBlack
methods.description: Fills the resource with black color.

methods.name: ChangeSource
methods.description: Changes the source resource of a Dispmanx element.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the video frame in the renderer.

methods.name: HideElement
methods.description: Hides the video element by setting a transparent resource.

methods.name: ShowElement
methods.description: Shows the previously hidden video element.
